VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify that the acceptance criteria have been met. While the agent claims all 47 tests pass and describes the fix in detail, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or other artifacts) to corroborate these claims. Self-reports are the weakest form of evidence and cannot establish that acceptance criteria have actually been satisfied without supporting documentation.
